style: Say in a friendly, youthful way, like a helpful older student
lines: Let's make a name song! Clap the name with me, and tap Clap for every clap.
Now tap a favorite thing.
Tap Clap for each part of the name. Then tap a favorite thing.
Tap Hear it to hear your song.
That's your song! Tap Practice when you are ready to sing.
First we sing it once. Tap Sing take 1. Watch the ball and sing.
Nice singing! Now let's listen. Tap Play take 1.
Nice singing! Show me with your thumb: how did it go? Tap Thumbs, or tap Pick a fix.
Pick one thing to make it even better. Tap a fix.
Tap Sing take 2, and try your fix.
Listen for your fix. Tap Play take 1, then Play take 2.
Think about your fix. Tap Take 1, Take 2 or Both good.
Our audience is waiting! Tap a feeling, then tap Perform.
No microphone. You can still practice: use thumbs.
Four claps is the most.
Tap Make, then tap Clap and a favorite thing to finish your song.
Listening to take 1. Tap Stop to stop.
Listening to take 2. Tap Stop to stop.
Louder! Big voices.
Softer. Gentle voices.
Steady beat. Listen for the clicks.
Higher sol. Reach up for the high note.
Clear words. Make every word sharp.
Take 1! Sometimes the first try is great.
Take 2! Practice made it better.
Both good! You're ready to perform.

I like puppies!
I like rainbows!
I like trains!
I like dinosaurs!
I like strawberries!
I like soccer!
I like butterflies!
I heard your name loud and clear!
Your voice sounded happy!
Your voice sounded sleepy!
Your voice sounded proud!
Your voice sounded silly!
I liked the high sol!
You kept the beat. Sing it again!
Watch the count, then sing with the ball. Tap Stop to stop.
Sing with the ball. Tap Stop to stop.
Tap Pick a fix to choose one thing to improve.
Tap Go to Perform to sing your chosen take for the audience.
Tap a feeling, then tap Perform to sing again.
Tap Yes, change it to clear both takes, or tap Keep my song.
No recording for this take. Tap Start over to record a new pair, or compare with thumbs.
